title: Consecutive reduction for two supplied descended stalk levels
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring, d an adic coefficient datum on A, phi_n isomorphisms from the constant A/I^(n+1) coefficient sheaves to the completed finite coefficient sheaves satisfying FinitePerfectModelsCompatible, and M a derived module over the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. Fix a connected X-etale chart V, a point v and an index n. Given single-level data Dprime at n+1 and D at n [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-etale-level-data], their small algebraic perfect fibres satisfy derivedExtension(A/I^(n+2) to A/I^(n+1))(Dprime.algebra) isomorphic to D.algebra [def-sfb-module-derived-scalar-comparisons]. This statement only compares two given levels; it constructs no descended level or tower.

source.place: Tag 09C6, looking locally on X to obtain consecutive algebraic scalar-extension isomorphisms; sites-cohomology.tex lemma-locally-constant-map (Tag 09BE).

proof.text: Apply finite-ring derived local constancy on connected V to each supplied bounded lisse etale complex at its chosen geometric point. Compose the two local stalk trivializations with their recorded universe-lift comparisons. Pull both trivializations to the intersection cover, using composition of derived inverse image and its compatibility with constant sheaves.

Choose a member of the intersection cover above v. The two transport fields give constant models of the actual consecutive quotients on this same nonempty X-etale chart. Apply scalar balancing of two constant models to conclude the claimed isomorphism.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_stalk_reduction
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (V : X.Etale) (hconn : ConnectedSpace V.left) (v : V.left) (n : ℕ)
    (D' : FinitePerfectAdicEtaleLevelData X d φ M V v (n + 1))
    (D : FinitePerfectAdicEtaleLevelData X d φ M V v n) :
    Nonempty
      ((ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))).obj D'.algebra ≅ D.algebra)
